purpose: Static resource ceilings for source-level computational and request-boundary design. Runtime SLOs remain deployment-specific.
rules: Static ceilings are safety/resource controls, not latency or availability guarantees.
Bound graph traversal and bulk reconciliation before iteration.
Prefer deterministic ordering and bounded database LIMITs.
Keep large exports/reports outside synchronous request handlers.
Deployment SLOs require production-like benchmark evidence.
Load, stress and soak remain final admission activities.
